for_generator.prompt: One single epic oil painting in the style of a 19th-century French romantic history painting (Delacroix, Géricault), rendered as a cinematic matte painting. Every element is painted with the same visible brushwork, the same warm golden light and the same deep navy shadows; nothing looks like a photograph. The scene flows as one continuous space from the sea on the left, through the barricade in the centre, to the Paris courtyard on the right, with smoke, clouds, sea spray and drifting golden haze overlapping every boundary. At the top centre, dominating the sky: Liberty from 'Liberty Leading the People' raising a muted tricolour flag, her crowd of revolutionaries dissolving into storm clouds and smoke. Behind the flag, a large thin gold hexagon emblem drawn in fine gold lines, with a faint gold constellation network radiating across the sky. On the left, a dark Atlantic at dusk: far on the horizon the next-generation French nuclear aircraft carrier 'France Libre' under way, and closer in the foreground swell a Triomphant-class ballistic missile submarine surfacing, its tall rounded sail cutting the waves, spray lit gold. In the centre, below Liberty, at the foot of the barricade: Kylian Mbappé in the France blue home jersey with the number 10, turned three-quarters toward the viewer so his face is clearly visible and recognisable, one fist raised toward Liberty, a clear second focal point of the painting, painted in the same oil-painting style and lit by the same golden light. On the right, the Louvre palace and its glass pyramid at blue hour, the pyramid glowing gold, its light reflected on wet paving stones that dissolve into sea mist and soft shadow in the lower right corner, which stays low in contrast but still painted. Dense, rich, layered composition with depth from foreground to sky; dark navy and antique gold palette with restrained tricolour accents; solemn, monumental mood.
